feedback: APPROVE. Spec is proportionate to the trivial refactor: canonical hello.py and test_hello.py contents are reproduced verbatim and match the working tree byte-for-byte (verified by Read). Data Schemas, Error Handling, and Integration Points are correctly marked N/A. API contract for greet() is precise (signature, semantics, examples). Test cases TC-1..TC-10 use behavioral assertions (literal-equality, exit codes, pytest counts) rather than brittle byte counts as the acceptance contract. Full traceability matrix Spec->Plan->TDD->PRD is present and complete. No blockers.

findings.message: TC-3 contains a parenthetical byte-count arithmetic note ('5+1+5+1 = 12 bytes'); it is correctly subordinated to the literal-equality check, but could be dropped to avoid any future drift risk.
